summary: Phase 3 Granular CRUD Permissions feature fully tested. All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. 17/17 backend tests passed. Full permissions workflow verified including user selection, permission matrix, save, and reset functionality.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/modules returns all modules grouped by 5 departments (marketing, sales, social, mail, admin)
Backend: Each module has required fields (id, name, description)
Backend: GET /api/admin/modules requires admin authentication (401 without token)
Backend: Non-admin cannot access modules endpoint (403)
Backend: GET /api/admin/users/{id}/permissions returns user permissions with correct structure
Backend: Returns 404 for non-existent user
Backend: PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/permissions saves custom permissions
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}/permissions resets to role defaults
Backend: /api/auth/me returns permissions in user object
Backend: /api/auth/me includes has_custom_permissions flag
Backend: POST /api/admin/permissions/check returns correct permission status
Backend: GET /api/admin/permissions/default/{role} returns role default permissions
Frontend: Admin can access Permissions page at /admin/permissions
Frontend: User selector dropdown shows all active users with their roles
Frontend: Selecting a user loads their current permissions in the matrix
Frontend: Permission matrix shows all 5 departments (Marketing, Sales, Social, Mail, Admin)
Frontend: Each module row shows CRUD checkboxes (View, Create, Edit, Delete, Export)
Frontend: Toggling a checkbox marks the form as having unsaved changes
Frontend: 'Unsaved Changes' badge and 'Save Changes' button appear when changes are made
Frontend: Saving permissions shows success toast and updates badge to 'Custom Permissions'
Frontend: 'Reset to Defaults' button appears for users with custom permissions
Frontend: Reset confirmation dialog works correctly
Frontend: Permissions reset to role defaults with success toast
Frontend: Sidebar has Administration section with 'User Management' and 'Permissions' links
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing users for permission testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Granular CRUD Permissions feature is fully implemented and tested. All backend APIs working: GET /api/admin/modules, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}/permissions, /api/auth/me includes permissions. Frontend Permission Management page at /admin/permissions fully functional with user selector, permission matrix, save/reset capabilities, and proper badges. Navigation link exists in sidebar under Administration section.
